lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is the 90 deg fold where arm 3/6 rises from the base plate (outer skins 2 and 6). In my perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer arc apex: the nearest cloud point is 0.22/0.05/0.14 mm away and there are no points on the outer side of the line. In the apex band the fold runs from t -0.5 to 17.7 mm, i.e. from the end of the relief slot to the arm's free edge. The line covers t 0 to 17.6, which is 97%. The material in the band at t < -2.5 is the flat wing of the base plate beyond the slot, not part of the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is the matching 90 deg root fold for arm 4/5 (outer skins 2 and 5). In the sections the nearest point is 0.34/0.03/0.03 mm away and the line is on the outer apex. The apex band runs from about t -0.3 to 17.8 and the line covers t 0 to 17.6, which is 97%. The line goes from the end of the relief slot to the arm edge and is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: This is the ~128 deg return-hook fold at the far end of arm 3/6, going to flange 10/12. The sections show a single smooth U-shaped arc with the line at the midpoint of the outer arc (nearest point 0.18/0.23/0.16 mm). The apex band runs from t -0.35 to 17.4 and the line covers t 0 to 16.8, which is 94% and spans the strip edge to edge.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: This is the ~128 deg return-hook fold at the far end of arm 4/5, going to flange 11/13. The sections show a single smooth arc with the line on the outer apex (nearest point 0.17/0.10/0.20 mm). The apex band runs from t -0.3 to 17.5 and the line covers t 0 to 17.16, which is 97% and runs edge to edge.
